(Photo by Cheng Xin/Getty Images)

Big Food companies appear to be backing disabled welfare recipients in a lawsuit against President Donald Trump’s Department of Agriculture (USDA) aiming to restore food stamp access to junk foods.

A number of autistic, diabetic, and otherwise disabled plaintiffs relying on the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) are suing USDA after Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins cut junk foods like soda and candy from the program.

One autistic plaintiffs claim the new restrictions prevent them from accessing “sensory regulating safe foods” to “prevent sensory overload, autistic shutdowns, or meltdowns.” Another plaintiff with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) claims she needs junk foods because “cooking is very difficult and she is not always able to process when she is hungry.”

But alongside the welfare recipients staking this lawsuit on their disabilities, a convenience store conglomerate with ties to the junk food industry appears to be bankrolling the effort. (RELATED: Autists, Diabetics Sue Trump Admin To Restore EBT Welfare Benefits For Junk Food)

The lawsuit names South Carolina Convenience & Petroleum Marketers Association (SCCPMA) as a plaintiff, boasting ties to some of the country’s most powerful food companies.

The self-proclaimed “voice of the petroleum & convenience store industry in South Carolina” features a star-studded cast of board members and corporate sponsors affiliated with big food companies.

NEW YORK, NEW YORK - NOVEMBER 06: “We Accept EBT” is posted outside a deli on November 06, 2025 in the Brooklyn borough of New York City. With the election of Zohran Mamdani as New York City’s next mayor, a new focus is being placed on the high cost of living in one of the world’s most expensive cities. Mamdani pledged on the campaign trail to freeze rents, tax the wealthy, and provide free buses for New Yorkers, among other issues. It is estimated that the cost of living in New York City is 132% higher than the national average. (Photo by Spencer Platt/Getty Images)

One of the top executives, Marty Postell, serves as Vice President of the Associate Members for SCCPMA while also serving as the General Manager of Sales for Coca-Cola in South Carolina. Bubba Hopkins, an Associate Board Member of SCCPMA, also works as the Sales Director at Carolina Bottling Cheerwine, which produces non-alcoholic soft drinks.

Both Cheerwine and Coca-Cola products were restricted in South Carolina on November 1, just 17 days before SCCPMA filed its lawsuit.

A 2016 USDA study found that soft drinks by expenditure were the top commodity for SNAP households, making up over $357 million in expenditures that year. Some estimates claim that roughly $23 billion of the $113 annual SNAP budget is spent on unhealthy foods and beverages. (RELATED: Store Allegedly Let Food Stamps Users Buy MILLIONS In Bongs, Pipes)

SCCPMA is also sponsored by a number of these food companies. Their summer convention listed Coca-Cola Consolidated as their top sponsor, with other companies like Frito-Lay, Pepsi, and J.M. Smucker backing the event.

Some notable products carried by brands like J.M. Smucker include Hostess, Jif, Dunkin, and Uncrustables. Frito-Lay’s product line includes popular chips like Cheetos, Doritos, Lay’s, Ruffles, and Fritos. All of these companies, including Coca-Cola, Pepsi, Frito-Lay, and J.M. Smucker, have been cut off from SNAP eligibility in states like South Carolina.

SCCPMA did not respond to a request for comment from the Daily Caller.
news.content:
(عکس از چنگ شین/گتی ایماژ)
به نظر می‌رسد شرکت‌های بزرگ مواد غذایی از دریافت‌کنندگان رفاه معلولان در شکایتی علیه وزارت کشاورزی رئیس‌جمهور دونالد ترامپ (USDA) با هدف بازگرداندن دسترسی به کوپن‌های غذایی به غذاهای ناسالم حمایت می‌کنند. تعدادی از شاکیان اوتیستیک، دیابتی و غیره که به برنامه کمک تغذیه تکمیلی (SNAP) متکی هستند، پس از اینکه بروک رولینز، وزیر کشاورزی، غذاهای ناخواسته مانند نوشابه و آب نبات را از برنامه حذف کرد، از USDA شکایت کردند. یکی از شاکیان اوتیسم ادعا می کند که محدودیت های جدید حسگر آنها را از دسترسی بیش از حد به مواد غذایی جلوگیری می کند. خاموشی یا بحران اوتیسم. یکی دیگر از شاکیان مبتلا به اختلال کمبود توجه و بیش فعالی (ADHD) ادعا می کند که به غذاهای ناسالم نیاز دارد زیرا "آشپزی بسیار دشوار است و او همیشه نمی تواند وقتی گرسنه است آن را پردازش کند."
اما در کنار دریافت‌کنندگان رفاهی که این شکایت را در مورد معلولیت‌های خود مطرح می‌کنند، به نظر می‌رسد یک مجموعه فروشگاه‌های رفاهی که با صنعت غذای ناسالم ارتباط دارد، این تلاش را تامین مالی می‌کند. (مرتبط: اوتیست ها و دیابتی ها از مدیر ترامپ برای بازگرداندن مزایای رفاهی EBT برای غذاهای ناسالم شکایت کردند)
در این دادخواست از انجمن بازاریابان نفت و راحتی کارولینای جنوبی (SCCPMA) به عنوان شاکی نام برده شده است که با برخی از قدرتمندترین شرکت های مواد غذایی کشور ارتباط دارد. این خودخوانده «صدای صنعت نفت و فروشگاه های رفاه در کارولینای جنوبی» دارای یک گروه ستاره دار از اعضای هیئت مدیره و حامیان مالی شرکت های وابسته به شرکت های بزرگ مواد غذایی است.

Screenshot of the Federal Aviation Administration’s Air Traffic Control System Command Center advisory on Wednesday night’s airport ground stop caused by a FedEx flight from Memphis overshooting its runway upon landing.

The incident involving the MD-11 operating FedEx Flight 910 occurred at approximately 8:40 p.m., prompting a complete halt to flights arriving at and departing from Miami International Airport (MIA). (RELATED: FAA Issues Nationwide Ground Stop, Halting All US Flight Departures)

One runway reopened for departures at 10:30 p.m., followed by a second at 12:17 a.m. Thursday. By 8 a.m. Thursday, three of the airport’s four runways had resumed operations, according to the Miami Herald.

The disruption primarily affected travelers scheduled to fly Wednesday evening, while Thursday morning passengers faced fewer disruptions as airport operations gradually returned to normal.

The Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office said Miami-Dade Fire Rescue reported no injuries among passengers, crew members, or people on the ground following the incident, according to a post on X.

The airport said in a post on X Thursday that, following the cargo jet’s runway overrun, three of its four runways had reopened, while Runway 8L-26R remained closed.

“Following last night’s FedEx Flight 910 runway overrun, three of our four runways are open, while Runway 8L-26R remains closed. As we experience some residual flight impacts today, please check directly with your airline for the latest updates before heading to the airport.”

Update: Following last night’s FedEx Flight 910 runway overrun, three of our four runways are open, while Runway 8L-26R remains closed. As we experience some residual flight impacts today, please check directly with your airline for the latest updates before heading to the airport. Our teams are working hard to safely restore normal operations. We are so grateful for your patience, cooperation, and holiday spirit as we get you where you need to be. Wishing everyone a safe and wonderful Thanksgiving.

The airport also thanked travelers for their patience and cooperation as crews worked to safely resume normal operations, while extending Thanksgiving wishes to passengers traveling for the holiday. (RELATED: FAA Lets Flights Resume After Hours-Long Ground Stop. Mullin Says Disruption Wasn’t A ‘Nefarious Attack.’)

Miami-Dade County Mayor Daniella Levine Cava put out a statement in response to the Wednesday night incident, writing on X, “I’m relieved to hear that no one was hurt. I know how difficult these delays are for so many families. Thank you to our first responders and airport teams working to get travelers safely to their loved ones tonight.”

The crash marked the second time in less than three months that a cargo aircraft overshot a runway while landing at Miami International Airport.

In a separate incident on Sept. 6, a Boeing 767 operated by 21 Air while transporting Amazon Prime cargo overshot the runway, striking a van beyond the airport grounds. (RELATED: At Least Five Dead, Five Injured In Fatal Amazon Plane Crash)

The crash killed five people inside the vehicle and left five others seriously injured.

New York’s Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) adopted new policies following a series of assaults, ambushes, and kidnappings targeting driving test examiners. However, union representatives say more needs to be done to protect workers.

In 2022, WNBC New York shared videos documenting several instances of student drivers threatening, harassing, and even attacking DMV examiners after learning they had failed their driving tests and would need to retake the exam. (RELATED: NYC’s Horse-Drawn Carriage Ban Could Send Hundreds Of Horses On One-Way Trip To Glue Factory)

“You give them the test. They’re smiling and friendly until you tell them they fail. Then the monster comes out,” Benjamin Greene, a motor vehicle license examiner and head of the Civil Service Employees Association’s (CSEA) DMV Unit, told WNBC.

After two decades in the industry, Greene said he had personally witnessed student drivers push examiners and, in one case, attempt to run an examiner over with their car. He added that one colleague was kidnapped when a student driver drove off with the examiner still inside the vehicle, taking her eight blocks away.

The incidents prompted the New York DMV to change its testing procedures. By early 2022, the agency told the Daily Caller that it had implemented a new system under which customers receive their road test results electronically after 6 p.m. on the day of their test.

“This is designed to protect the integrity of the test and enable the results to be provided in a safe and secure manner to all customers,” the state’s DMV said in a statement.

The change appeared to reduce confrontations, but did not eliminate them. One examiner told WNBC that harassment became less frequent after the DMV stopped providing immediate test results.

People wait at the New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) office at Atlantic Center in the Brooklyn borough of New York on December 18, 2019. (Photo by ANGELA WEISS/AFP via Getty Images)

“I do have to say that once the instant notification ended it wasn’t as frequent, but recently — probably six months ago — I had somebody threaten me because they didn’t have the proper paperwork to go out on the test,” the examiner, Michael Ko, said.

Four years after the policy change, CSEA members have provided positive feedback, but union President Mary E. Sullivan told the Caller that “more needs to be done.”

“CSEA continues to advocate for stronger workplace safety protections, including increased criminal penalties for individuals who assault DMV road test examiners,” Sullivan said.

Sullivan was referring to the union’s calls for increased penalties for assaults on DMV workers, including an attack on an employee in 2025.

A the New York State DMV is seen on April 28, 2025 in New York City. (Photo by Michael M. Santiago/Getty Images)

Since 2023, two bills and provisions in three budget bills seeking to classify assaults on vehicle license examiners as assault in the second degree have either failed or expired in the state legislature.

If any of these had been passed, the legislation would have lowered the threshold for injuries required to bring felony charges against those who assault DMV road test examiners and mandated a minimum two-year prison sentence upon conviction. Similar protections are already in place for New York police officers, firefighters, emergency medical technicians, bus and subway workers, sanitation workers, traffic enforcement agents and school employees.

Now, as of late November, nearly identical bills are sitting in committees in both the Senate and Assembly, where they are likely to stall and expire at the end of the year.

Sullivan continued, “No public employee should have to fear for their safety simply for doing their job.”
news.content:
(عکس از Michael M. Santiago/Getty Images)
دپارتمان وسایل نقلیه موتوری نیویورک (DMV) پس از یک سری حملات، کمین‌ها و آدم‌ربایی‌ها با هدف قرار دادن ممتحنین آزمون رانندگی، سیاست‌های جدیدی را اتخاذ کرد. با این حال، نمایندگان اتحادیه می گویند که باید اقدامات بیشتری برای حمایت از کارگران انجام شود. در سال 2022، WNBC نیویورک ویدئوهایی را به اشتراک گذاشت که چندین مورد از تهدید، آزار و حتی حمله رانندگان دانش آموز به ممتحنین DMV را پس از اینکه متوجه شدند در آزمون های رانندگی خود مردود شده اند و باید دوباره در امتحان شرکت کنند را به اشتراک گذاشت. (مرتبط: ممنوعیت کالسکه اسب کشیده نیویورک می تواند صدها اسب را به یک طرفه به کارخانه چسب بفرستد)
شما آنها را امتحان می کنید. آنها خندان و دوستانه هستند تا زمانی که به آنها بگویید شکست می خورند. سپس هیولا بیرون می‌آید.» بنجامین گرین، بازرس گواهینامه وسایل نقلیه موتوری و رئیس واحد DMV انجمن کارکنان خدمات عمومی (CSEA) به WNBC گفت. پس از دو دهه فعالیت در این صنعت، گرین گفت که شخصا شاهد بوده است که رانندگان دانش‌آموزی ممتحنین را تحت فشار قرار داده‌اند و در یک مورد، تلاش می‌کردند یک ممتحن را با ماشینشان زیر پا بگذارند. او افزود که یکی از همکارانش ربوده شد زمانی که یک دانش آموز راننده در حالی که ممتحن هنوز داخل وسیله نقلیه بود حرکت کرد و او را هشت بلوک دورتر برد. این حوادث باعث شد پلیس نیویورک DMV روش های آزمایش خود را تغییر دهد. در اوایل سال 2022، آژانس به Daily Caller گفت که سیستم جدیدی را پیاده سازی کرده است که بر اساس آن مشتریان نتایج تست جاده خود را بعد از ساعت 6 بعد از ظهر به صورت الکترونیکی دریافت می کنند. در روز آزمون آنها "این برای محافظت از یکپارچگی th طراحی شده است

news.originalContent:
Photo by Kent NISHIMURA / AFP via Getty Images

A GOP senator is warning that the White House shouldn’t be deciding who runs one of the country’s most valuable companies.

Republican Sen. Dave McCormick of Pennsylvania said the executive branch should stay out of corporate ownership deals and boardroom leadership calls and that interfering sets a “dangerous precedent,” according to a video statement he posted on X. Decisions about who leads a company and how its board governs belong to the private sector, the freshman senator said.

I don’t know exactly what the president’s calculus was here, but I am worried about the precedent. I believe the private sector should be making decisions about corporate leadership and board governance. That doesn’t mean government has no role. In critical industries like semiconductors and shipbuilding, targeted support can be essential to our national security. But to avoid a dangerous precedent, we need clear and consistent limits on when government intervenes. We don’t want to go down the road of state capitalism and undermine the very system that makes America competitive.

His comments come after President Donald Trump publicly backed the return of ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and claimed to have “made the deal” that got him his job back. Leaving the White House for a trip to Asia on Nov. 16, Trump told reporters he would welcome seeing Huang reinstated, The Hill reported. “I think he learned a big lesson,” Trump said. (RELATED: Trump Says Pardoning Jensen Huang Is ‘Always An Option,’ But Probably Won’t Be ‘Necessary’)

Huang had stepped down on Nov. 12, with finance chief Colette Kress taking over on an interim basis and longtime director Harvey Jones installed as the company’s first board chairman, Fortune reported. The board said it would weigh both internal and external candidates for the permanent job.

Nvidia’s directors closed the door on a comeback the following week. Jones told investors at the start of the company’s Nov. 17 earnings call that the board unanimously accepted the resignation and had no intention of reinstating Huang.

Huang offered a conditional return in an X post the same day, writing that he would be “honored” to come back if directors judged it best for shareholders, employees, the company, and America.

عکس از کنت نیشیمورا / خبرگزاری فرانسه از طریق گتی ایماژ
یک سناتور جمهوری خواه هشدار می دهد که کاخ سفید نباید تصمیم بگیرد که چه کسی یکی از با ارزش ترین شرکت های کشور را اداره می کند. سناتور جمهوری خواه دیو مک کورمیک از پنسیلوانیا گفت که شاخه اجرایی باید از معاملات مالکیت شرکتی و درخواست های رهبری اتاق هیئت مدیره خودداری کند و بر اساس بیانیه ایکس که او منتشر کرد، "سابقه خطرناکی" ایجاد می کند. سناتور سال اول گفت که تصمیمات در مورد اینکه چه کسی یک شرکت را رهبری می کند و نحوه اداره هیئت مدیره آن مربوط به بخش خصوصی است. من معتقدم بخش خصوصی باید در مورد رهبری شرکتی و مدیریت هیئت مدیره تصمیم گیری کند. این بدان معنا نیست که دولت نقشی ندارد. در صنایع حیاتی مانند نیمه هادی ها و کشتی سازی، پشتیبانی هدفمند می تواند برای امنیت ملی ما ضروری باشد. اما برای جلوگیری از یک سابقه خطرناک، ما به محدودیت‌های روشن و ثابتی در مورد زمان مداخله دولت نیاز داریم. ما نمی‌خواهیم راه سرمایه‌داری دولتی را طی کنیم و همان سیستمی را که آمریکا را رقابتی می‌کند، تضعیف کنیم. اظهارات وی پس از آن بیان شد که دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا علناً از بازگشت جنسن هوانگ، مدیر عامل برکنار شده انویدیا حمایت کرد و مدعی شد که "معامله ای را انجام داده است" که او شغلش را پس گرفته است. به گزارش هیل، ترامپ هنگام ترک کاخ سفید برای سفر به آسیا در 16 نوامبر به خبرنگاران گفت که از بازگرداندن هوانگ در سمت خود استقبال خواهد کرد. ترامپ گفت: فکر می کنم او درس بزرگی گرفت. No IDF troops were injured in the drone launches, and the military said it immediately began striking Hezbollah infrastructure in several areas across southern Lebanon, including what it said was a weapons storage facility.   No IDF troops were injured in the drone launches, and the military said it immediately began striking Hezbollah infrastructure in several areas across southern Lebanon, including what it said was a weapons storage facility. A vehicle in which two people were killed. The Associated Press reported that the vehicle belonged to the Lebanese Scout and Rescue Association, Al-Risala, and that one of those killed was a paramedic with the organization. Two other people were wounded. At the same time, Lebanese reports said a building in Kfar Reman where a large number of people were staying was also struck, killing nine people, including women and children, and wounding 11 others.   Prior to the strikes, steps were taken to mitigate harm to uninvolved individuals, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance," the IDF said in response. "The claim that several uninvolved individuals were harmed as a result of the strikes is being reviewed.” The IDF said that, in addition, following the launch of the explosive drones Sunday, “the IDF struck in the Nabatieh area and eliminated several Hezbollah terrorists. "The IDF will not allow the Hezbollah terrorist organization to harm Israeli civilians or IDF soldiers and will continue to operate to remove threats while remaining committed to the ceasefire agreement." “We lived under constant intimidation because of the bombardments on the outskirts of the village,” Fouad Chakroun, a resident of Kfar Reman told AP as he stood in front of the destroyed building. “Now they have struck the heart of the village.” Another resident, Saleh Madlij, said families and children had been staying in the building. “Are there missiles here?” he said sarcastically. “I will not leave this place.” The BBC reported that, according to Lebanese media, seven additional people were killed in strikes Sunday, while Lebanese President Joseph Aoun warned that the attacks represented a “dangerous escalation” that threatened the ceasefire.

news.originalContent: Senior government officials admit that Israel's public opinion in the international community "has never been worse." According to them, the situation only worsens, and the support the world has shown Israel following Hamas’s attack on October 7 has already been forgotten.  Follow Ynetnews on Facebook | Twitter | Instagram | TikTok >> More stories: IDF releases name of fallen soldier in West Bank terror attack UN chief in Rafah crossing says world 'seen enough' of Gaza war Two Air Force pilots reminisce about their murdered brothers: 'There's no room for pain in the air' The officials added that the intensity of accusations made against Israel only increases, and attempts to equate Hamas's actions in Israel are being made, with allegations accusing IDF soldiers of sexually harassing Palestinian prisoners. Ministers in the government blame Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for the complete neglect of Israel’s public relations: "There’s no leader present it’s been abandoned. A pandemic of sanctions against Israel may break out, and if we don't wake up, it will be too late. Something big needed to be done in terms of public relations, we need to rally the Jewish people and launch an international campaign. There’s no leader to head this. We’re losing. Our friends tell us: we support you, but you’re losing in the court of public opinion." A senior figure in Israel's advocacy efforts added, "They neutralized the Foreign Ministry and took away all its budget. The Foreign Ministry has no funding. To this day, no money was delivered. We’re working with a budget of 2 million shekels allocated for the war since the beginning of the year.  “Each U.S. consulate receives $5,000 a year for public relations efforts, including Independence Day events. For example, the consulate in Boston, which is also responsible for MIT, has to struggle to have such an amount. It’s ridiculous. When you already have a talented spokesman like Eylon Levy, they unjustly suspend him. He was one of the few people who did his mission in the most talented, beautiful, and correct way, and they sent him home,” the source said.   Internal reports from Israeli missions in the United States describe a very harsh picture of Israeli coverage in the American media. One report described, "The media awaited a sign from the government for a policy change, and when it arrived - it unleashed a rampage and published constant harsh criticism against Israel that had always existed. The harsh reports from Gaza, alongside internal tensions in the U.S., threaten to push moderate writers from the mainstream to adopt critical positions toward Israel and demand an immediate and permanent cease-fire.” 'the graphic images undermine the war’s legitimacy' “Pressure on the Biden administration to harden its stance toward Israel and condition military aid for an Israeli policy change constitutes a warning sign for the future,” the report added. “In terms of 'color,' we’re currently in a 'dark orange.' “There’s a change in stances even among staunch supporters of Israel – and while the conservative media fully supported Israel's actions in the past, this time voices questioning the proportionality of Israeli action have also been heard. However, no demand for a cease-fire is expected to appear in those media outlets. Without a fundamental change in the humanitarian issue in Gaza and/or signs on the diplomatic solution on the horizon, criticism of Israel in the media is expected to intensify,” the report read. It was added, "In the last month, the U.S. media’s spotlight turned to the worsening humanitarian crisis in Gaza, with special emphasis given to the suffering of Rafah residents against the backdrop of the possibility of the IDF expanding the ground operation there as well. Leading media outlets flooded screens and front pages with images of starving children, trauma victims, and the destruction of homes and hospitals. Reports and personal stories from Rafah led to empathy toward the Palestinians’ suffering and anger toward Israel's military actions. "Although most media outlets refrained from blaming Israel for creating the crisis intentionally or denying its right to self-defense, opinion pieces sparked fierce debate regarding the proportionality and morality of the ongoing military operation in its current form. Critical voices that were once silenced now have a wider platform.    “Reports focused on the immense humanitarian damages and the harm to innocent civilians, which many analysts argue is unjustified and goes against the values of the IDF’s operation. Even publicists who supported Israel in the past admitted that the graphic images undermine the war’s legitimacy,” the report read. “Against this backdrop, a narrative is emerging among liberal authors, which sees the Biden administration and its policy of providing weapons and diplomatic support to Israel as responsible for the situation, or at least as someone who can bring it to an end." Furthermore, dozens of recent opinion pieces represent a wide range of positions regarding the IDF’s legitimacy, the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, the question of a cease-fire, and the future of U.S.-Israel relations: Conservative media outlets like The Wall Street Journal and The New York Post fully support Israel, advocate for continued military action against Hamas, and refrain from calling for an immediate and prolonged stop to the war.  In contrast, newspapers identified with the center and liberal left, including The New York Times and The Washington Post, criticize the war’s escalation, citing the destructive consequences of the confrontation on Palestinian civilians, and therefore calling for an immediate humanitarian cease-fire, the reports explained.   The reports also expose an erosion of Israel's standing in Washington against the backdrop of the escalation in the Gaza war. This was clearly reflected in U.S. President Joe Biden's statement regarding a "red line" on military operations in Rafah, and Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer's speech.  Most analysts don’t foresee an immediate shift in relations between the countries, but caution against potential political damage to both sides. Furthermore, calls are increasing to use American military aid to Israel as leverage to force policy change in Jerusalem. However, warnings have been raised that the fact of having this discussion could bolster Hamas's position and undermine the chances of a cease-fire.  While conservative media outlets present Israel's policy as legitimate self-defense, liberal media outlets provide a platform for writers who echo the Palestinian narrative, sometimes using rhetoric accusing Israel of "apartheid" and even "genocide." Calls for the U.S. government to distance itself from supporting Israel and reconsider its military aid plan are becoming more common, even in moderate media outlets. The report mentions articles in The Washington Post and The Daily Beast highlighting the effectiveness of pro-Palestinian activists in influencing public opinion in the U.S., especially among progressive Democratic voters. The articles point to growing discontent with the Biden administration's support for Israel, reflected in "Uncommitted" votes in the Democratic primaries and disruptions at party events. Tactics such as demanding a cease-fire and using the term "genocide" have succeeded in keeping the war at the forefront of the national political agenda and increasing pressure on Washington to minimize its support of Israel.  The increasing willingness of Democratic politicians to criticize Israel suggests a shift in the party's traditional stance and leads to speech free of restraint in media outlets as well. This trend reached its zenith with Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer's speech, in which he labeled Netanyahu an "obstacle to peace" and accused him of damaging Israel's international standing, calling for early Israeli elections.

news.originalContent: Rather than celebrating and resting over the three-day holiday, residents of the Jewish community of Hendon in north London and Radlett were struck by shock and grief after the deadly terror attack that took the lives of two daughters of their beloved and esteemed Rabbi Leo Dee, on Friday, the second day of Passover which is considered a holly day in diaspora communities.   Follow Ynetnews on Facebook and Twitter >> Related stories: Israel names two sisters killed in West Bank terror attack At least one dead and six injured in a terror attack in Tel Aviv Family loses two daughters to deadly terror attack Members of the Jewish London community, including friends of the family, who heard of the devastating news after the Shabbat ended, were confronted only then, with the horrific reports of Maia and Rina's death. The funerals for the Dee sisters will be held today at the Kfar Etzion Cemetery.   Rabbi Leo Dee served as the Assistant Rabbi at the Hendon United Synagogue in North London from 2008-2011, and as the Senior Rabbi at Radlett United Synagogue from 2011-2014, after which the family made aliyah. They were a much beloved and respected family in the UK Jewish community. “People feel shock and disappointment. The family were communal people and served their communities well and were well-liked.” said a former member of the congregation at Hendon United Synagogue who did not wish to be named.  “I feel sick seeing this… good people who would never hurt anyone, murdered. I can't imagine his anguish, and pray Lucy survives,” said Joseph, another former congregant.   Chief UK Rabbi Sir Ephraim Mirvis laments the death of the British-Israeli girls murdered in Friday's terror strike on the West Bank.  In a statement, the rabbi said: "No words can describe the depth of our shock and sadness at the heartbreaking news of the murder by terrorists in Israel of Maya & Rina Dee, daughters of Rebbetzen Lucy, who is in a critical condition & Rabbi Leo Dee, my dear colleagues. He continued, “They were much loved in the Hendon and Radlett communities in the UK, as well as in Israel and well beyond.” UK statement not mentioning terrorism The British Board of Deputies also issued a statement expressing shock over the tragic attack: “We are deeply shocked and saddened at the murder by Palestinian terrorists of Maia and Rina Dee, the daughters of Rabbi Leo and Lucy Dee formerly of Radlett United Synagogue. We wish Lucy Refuah Shlemah and long life to the family as they cope with this devastating news.” Palestinian terrorist shot and killed 2 British-Israeli nationals, also critically injuring their mother in the West Bank. The victims were identified Saturday as 15-year-old Rina Dee and 20-year-old Maia Dee, the daughters of British-born Rabbi Leo Dee.  While their mother, Lucy (Lea), remains in critical condition fighting for her life, the Jewish community in the UK has expressed shock and sorrow at the brutal act of terrorism against former members of their community.    While many Jewish community leaders spoke out about the attack, the UK government has received criticism from some members of the community for its weakly-worded response to the killing of two of its own citizens.  One member of the Jewish community told Ynet that it was shocking that the UK statement didn’t even mention terrorism. “The response would be different if this happened elsewhere in the world. There is a double standard for British people killed in Israel,” he said.  The UK’s official statement read: “We are saddened to hear about the deaths of two British-Israeli citizens and the serious injuries sustained by a third individual. The UK calls for all parties across the region to de-escalate tensions.” "Tragedy for global Jewish community" Avi Abelow, family friend, said Rabbi Leo and Lucy Dee are beloved and active members of their community in Efrat. "Two of the sweetest people with the sweetest children", he added. "Rabbi Leo continues to teach Torah classes in his Efrat synagogue today. All the youth of Efrat, as their families, are mourning the loss of either their personal friend or the sibling of their personal friend."  He mentioned that "Just last night the whole community got together, including many youth, for a special communal prayer gathering to pray for Lucy's recovery. The brutal Arab Muslim terrorist attack that murdered these two young, innocent Jewish women, and seriously injured their mother fighting for her life, is not just a tragedy for their family, but for the whole Efrat community and the global Jewish community.  "At the same time that another terrorist committed a terror attack in Tel Aviv, which killed an Italian tourist, and terrorist organizations are shooting rockets at Israel from Lebanon, Syria and Gaza, we are once again reminded that the Jewish people have enemies trying to kill us everywhere in our country for just being Jews living in our ancestral homeland.  "If only the UK government and other global bodies would recognize this truth, and truly give support to Israel to stop this ongoing terror war against Israel, which causes loss of life for everyone. In the meantime, as a personal friend and neighbor of the Dee family, my family, neighbors, and community will continue to assist and comfort the Dee family, as we assisted and comforted the family of our other friend and neighbor, Ari Fuld, murdered by terrorists back in 2018."

Ynetnews را در فیس بوک و توییتر دنبال کنید >> مطالب مرتبط: اسراییل نام دو خواهر کشته شده در حمله تروریستی کرانه باختری را اعلام کرد حداقل یک کشته و شش زخمی در حمله تروریستی در تل آویو خانواده دو دختر خود را در حمله تروریستی مرگبار از دست دادند اعضای جامعه یهودی لندن از جمله دوستان خانواده که پس از پایان شبات از اخبار ویرانگر شنیده بودند، تنها در آن زمان با گزارش های وحشتناک ری از مرگ مواجه شدند. مراسم تشییع پیکر خواهران دی امروز در قبرستان کفار اتزیون برگزار می شود.   خاخام لئو دی به عنوان دستیار خاخام در کنیسه هندون یونایتد در شمال لندن از سال 2008 تا 2011، و به عنوان خاخام ارشد در کنیسه رادلت یونایتد از سال 2011 تا 2014 خدمت کرد، پس از آن خانواده به عنوان الیه درآمدند. آنها خانواده ای بسیار محبوب و مورد احترام در جامعه یهودیان بریتانیا بودند. «مردم احساس شوک و ناامیدی می کنند. این خانواده افراد جمعی بودند و به خوبی به جوامع خود خدمت می کردند و مورد پسند بودند.» یکی از اعضای سابق جماعت کنیسه یونایتد هندون که نمی خواست نامش فاش شود، گفت.  من از دیدن این احساس بدم می‌آید... آدم‌های خوبی که هرگز به کسی صدمه نمی‌زنند، به قتل رسیده‌اند. من می توانم

news.originalContent: Iran's powerful Revolutionary Guards warned anti-government protesters of "decisive" action if unrest over gasoline price hikes do not cease, state television reported on Monday. The warning appeared to hint at a looming crackdown on protests that flared nationwide in response to an official announcement on Friday of gasoline rationing and price hikes of at least 50 percent. "If necessary we will take decisive and revolutionary action against any continued moves to disturb the people's peace and security," the Guards said in a statement carried by state media.
news.content: تلویزیون دولتی روز دوشنبه گزارش داد که سپاه پاسداران قدرتمند ایران به معترضان ضد دولتی هشدار داد که اگر ناآرامی ها بر سر افزایش قیمت بنزین متوقف نشود، اقدام «قاطعانه» خواهند کرد. به نظر می‌رسد این هشدار به سرکوب اعتراض‌هایی که در سراسر کشور در واکنش به اعلام رسمی روز جمعه مبنی بر سهمیه‌بندی بنزین و افزایش حداقل 50 درصدی قیمت‌ها شعله‌ور شد، اشاره می‌کند. سپاه پاسداران در بیانیه‌ای که توسط رسانه‌های دولتی منتشر شد، گفت: «در صورت لزوم، در برابر هرگونه اقدام مستمر برای برهم زدن آرامش و امنیت مردم، اقدام قاطع و انقلابی خواهیم کرد».
